maria_support: Heads-up — customer reported 5–10s tail latency on /v1/generate and pasted the original prompt which includes an email + order id. Can Eng help gather repro steps and confirm how much we can redact before handing to Product?

dan_engineer: Sure. Can you share the request_id from their error logs? Also a minimal curl (without tokens) helps. Avoid sending full emails or payment data in channel.

maria_support: request_id=req_202a7f9c

maria_support: Customer's original curl (redact token):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: req_202a7f9c" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1","input":"Customer email: alice@example.com, order 12345, issue: order failed"}'
```

kyle_oncall: don't paste real email publicly. Replace with `<EMAIL_HASH>` or `alice@<REDACTED_DOMAIN>` before uploading. Also remove any SDK keys.

maria_support: updated curl (pseudonymized):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: req_202a7f9c" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1","input":"Customer email: <EMAIL_HASH>, order <ORDER_ID_HASH>, issue: order failed"}'
```

dan_engineer: Good. Next steps for repro bundle collection: run `support-cli collect --request-id req_202a7f9c --include-logs --scrub-ids` and attach the result to the ticket. If you can't run that, provide the following:
- exact occurrence time (TZ)
- region
- whether customer is hosted/dedicated

maria_support: Occurred 2026-03-15T18:42:12Z, region=us-west-2, customer on Dedicated.

privacy_bot: Reminder: debug bundles may contain raw prompts. Always run the scrub script before sharing: `tools/scrub_prompts.sh bundle.tar.gz`. Internal doc: https://intranet/redwood/privacy/scrub-guidelines

legal_jade: Note — if the bundle includes unredacted payment/account numbers we need a processing waiver for Dedicated customers. Maria, flag if you see any payment tokens.

maria_support: No payment numbers detected, only email and order id.

kyle_oncall: I'll pull the runtime traces and kv metrics now. ETA ~25m. Will post a scrubbed bundle to secure S3 when ready. :thumbsup:

dan_engineer: Once we have traces, check `token_decode` and `kv_cache_miss` spikes. If latency correlates with input size, recommend truncation or use prefix caching. Also check for `model_fallback` events.

maria_support: Copy — will wait.

kyle_oncall: bundle uploaded to secure-share: s3://redwood-support-debug/scrubbed/req_202a7f9c_bundle.tar.gz

maria_support: received and downloading. Quick question — there's one placeholder left `alice@<REDACTED_DOMAIN>` in the prompt. Is that OK to share with Product for triage?

privacy_bot: That's allowed only if the domain is redacted. If you want extra safety, run `hash_email.sh alice@<REDACTED_DOMAIN>` and replace with a hex hash.

maria_support: hashed and replaced, uploaded new bundle. Thanks all. :pray:
